LESSON: BELIEF IN REVEALED SCRIPTURES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.1: Belief in revealed scriptures

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Belief in revealed scriptures. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can Muslims practise religious tolerance?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman
2. explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind
3. identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance
4. describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance
5. practise tolerance towards people of other faiths for peaceful co-existence, g) acknowledge the revealed scriptures as part of faith

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BELIEF IN REVEALED SCRIPTURES
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Belief in revealed scriptures helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BELIEF IN REVEALED SCRIPTURES
Study Belief in revealed scriptures like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Belief in revealed scriptures” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Belief in revealed scriptures in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance

What this means
In this part you learn to describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Belief in revealed scriptures” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 5: Practise tolerance towards people of other faiths for peaceful co-existence, g) acknowledge the revealed scriptures as part of faith

What this means
In this part you learn to practise tolerance towards people of other faiths for peaceful co-existence, g) acknowledge the revealed scriptures as part of faith. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise tolerance towards people of other faiths for peaceful co-existence, g) acknowledge the revealed scriptures as part of faith.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Belief in revealed scriptures in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise tolerance towards people of other faiths for peaceful co-existence, g) acknowledge the revealed scriptures as part of faith. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Belief in revealed scriptures is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Belief in revealed scriptures” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Belief in revealed scriptures in your own words. (skill: explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance)

Example 4: Show how “Belief in revealed scriptures” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Belief in revealed scriptures to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman.
3. Practise this skill: explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind.
4. Practise this skill: identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Belief in revealed scriptures from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Belief in revealed scriptures: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Belief in revealed scriptures?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can Muslims practise religious tolerance?
2. Why does mankind need revealed scriptures?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Belief in revealed scriptures means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman.
5. Be able to: explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
